selected.title: Stevie Wonder · Isn't She Lovely · chord color
selected.focus: Sevenths and ninths over a moving bass
selected.cue: Listen to four bars of melody, keyboard voicings and bass. In bar 1, B and D-sharp add a seventh and ninth above C-sharp; the bass then moves to F-sharp, B and E.
selected.credit: Community MIDI via BitMidi; original transcriber not identified
selected.terms: Private local review; public-app reuse permission not established; file is not bundled with the application
selected.note: A 3:45 community arrangement was obtained; this is a four-bar reduction. The opening keyboard notes E/G-sharp/B/D-sharp sit over C-sharp bass, giving C-sharp minor ninth color. The following F-sharp bass supports A-sharp/E/G-sharp in the keyboard. The melody-guide horn plays on sampled piano. Other synth, guitar, string, harmonica and percussion parts are omitted, including two non-GM percussion lanes encoded as pitched notes. The original timing is retained; fine swing and expressive placements may require the piano-roll view. This is not an approved transcription of the album recording.

selected.title: Daft Punk · Around the World · building layers
selected.focus: Repeated parts enter at different moments
selected.cue: Follow the bass and high repeating figure. A second figure enters in excerpt bar 3, a new middle part in bar 13, and the vocal line in bar 21. The parts keep their individual rhythms as the texture grows.
selected.credit: Kevin Hall, credited in the MIDI; hosted by Albino Blacksheep
selected.terms: Private local review; public-app reuse permission not established; file is not bundled with the application
selected.note: A seven-minute, 10,605-note community arrangement was obtained; this is a 24-bar reduction. The selected new lanes start at source beats 56, 96 and 129.5. Synth and vocal pitches play on piano, and the bass uses the bass sound; original filtering, timbres and production are not reproduced. Noise effects, later synth lanes and extra percussion are omitted. The source C-major metadata is not treated as an approved key analysis.

selected.title: Queen · Bohemian Rhapsody · section transition
selected.focus: A contrasting passage changes the pace and texture
selected.cue: Hear the choral passage give way to a faster guitar-led setting near excerpt bar 8. The tempo changes from about 124 to 176 bpm, while new guitar parts replace the previous texture. This passage shows one boundary within the larger form.
selected.credit: Community MIDI via BitMidi; original transcriber not identified
selected.terms: Private local review; public-app reuse permission not established; file is not bundled with the application
selected.note: A long community arrangement with tempo and meter changes was obtained. It lasts about 7:22 and is not certified as a faithful full-song transcription. This selected passage preserves the source tempo change at beat 385.5 (excerpt beat 30.5) and the new guitar-chord entrance at beat 385.02. Choral and guitar notes use piano for clarity; doubled guitar, other choir lanes, effects and extra percussion are omitted. This 16-bar boundary study does not establish the complete song form. A full section map and recording alignment remain to be reviewed. Expressive subdivisions may require the piano-roll view.
